description: Ring modulator built on a model of a diode ring, multiplying a signal by a carrier

params.text: Blends between the untouched signal fully counter-clockwise and the ring-modulated signal fully clockwise

inputs.text: The signal to be modulated, and its channel count sets the channel count of the output
The carrier the signal is multiplied by

outputs.text: The blend of modulated and untouched signal
